name: Crushridge Bounty
summary: From Southshore, Marshal Redpath warns that Crushridge ogres have settled near Alterac's ruins. He offers a bounty to anyone who hunts them in the Alterac Mountains.

sections.title: Ogres at the Door
sections.body: Marshal Redpath sends you north after reports that Crushridge ogres have dug a mound in the Alterac Mountains near Alterac's ruined city. They have taken the ruins too. Redpath fears they may grow comfortable there, then move down into the foothills and reach Southshore's door. He offers a bounty for hunting them and bringing back the Dirty Knucklebones they carry.

faq.q: Why does Marshal Redpath want the Crushridge ogres hunted?
faq.answer: Redpath fears the Crushridge ogres may grow comfortable in their mound and Alterac's ruins, then move down into the foothills toward Southshore's door.
The Crushridge ogres are north in the Alterac Mountains. They have built a mound near Alterac's ruined city, and Redpath's scouts report they hold the ruins too.

faq.q: What does Marshal Redpath want brought back?
faq.answer: Marshal Redpath wants nine Dirty Knucklebones carried by the Crushridge ogres brought back to him in Southshore.
